steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Put every appointment from the CRM on your Google Calendar.

steps.caption: The feed link
steps.narration: In Settings, scroll to Calendar. The first part is a private feed link, for any calendar app.

steps.caption: Company Google Calendar
steps.narration: The second part is the company Google Calendar.

steps.caption: Every appointment
steps.narration: Every appointment is written into a calendar named ConstructHub CRM, in the Google account you connect.

steps.caption: Connected
steps.narration: You connect once, by signing in on Google's own screen. Here it is already connected.

steps.caption: Last synced
steps.narration: Under that: when it was connected, and when it last synced.

steps.caption: Sync now
steps.narration: Choose Sync now to push your schedule straight away.

steps.caption: Synced
steps.narration: The last synced time changes to now.

steps.caption: Team & Company
steps.narration: One more place: Team and Company, on the My profile tab.

steps.caption: My Google Calendar
steps.narration: Each team member can connect their own Google Calendar here, for their own appointments only.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: The company calendar is in Settings, in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to sync your schedule with Google Calendar | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: See where ConstructHUB CRM connects to Google Calendar: the company calendar that carries every appointment, Sync now, and the personal calendar each team member can connect. Recorded in a demo workspace with a stand-in calendar already connected; connecting itself happens on Google's sign-in screen.
